d:
26 July 2026. Dharmendra Pradhan has resigned. This was shot before he did.
For three days — 21st, 22nd and 23rd July — Vinamre put the phone down, turned off the reels and went to Jantar Mantar with a press card and no research. This is what came back: a monologue recorded on the way home, unedited conversations with the people actually standing in that crowd, and footage from the other side of the police line. He went in expecting woke JNU types. He did not come out with the video he planned to make.
Watch it with an open mind. Then go see it for yourself.
